consequence.statement: When cert-manager deletes DNS records in AWS Route53, it now correctly detects not-found errors. This is a bug fix and needs no operator action.

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 fixes how the AWS Route53 DNS01 solver detects not-found errors when it deletes DNS records.

decision.reason: [ev-23e99dfde8d0] is a "Bug or Regression" note saying only that cert-manager now correctly detects AWS Route53 not-found errors when it deletes DNS records. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured, loses access or must be migrated, so a failure kind is not supported. It does say the deletion path now behaves differently in one case, so a low-severity behavior-change (review) is a careful choice. It avoids claiming mandatory work and does not assert "none" without support.
